visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fixed set of side-by-side feature groups (heading + bullet list each)
visualCharacteristics.description: Fixed row of equal-width text-only feature columns (4-up on desktop, 2-up tablet, stacked mobile). Each column: small bold heading followed by a compact left-aligned bullet list, some bullets containing inline links. No images, no borders.

contentPattern.structure: One Feature Column item per column (UE container item, single richtext cell: H4 heading + bullet list). Document-authored tables may instead use one row with one cell per column; both are accepted

reuseGuidance: Use for a small fixed set (2-4) of different feature groups shown side by side, each a heading plus a bullet list. Use cards for look-alike linked items.
